entries.084a9c368eecbb11: Since its founding in 1915, the company has continued developing products that make use of the properties of carbon, and has repeatedly industrialized new carbon materials, including artificial graphite electrodes in 1927, carbon fiber in 1962, and silicon carbide continuous fiber in 1983. Research and development is conducted by the Technical Center in coordination with the sales division and in cooperation with the technical divisions of each business site, with an emphasis on semiconductor-related and environment-related fields.

entries.0fac306737775b0d: Revenue is centered on carbon product-related products, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥32,397 million. Silicon carbide product-related revenue was ¥4,128 million, and other revenue was ¥1,209 million. By region, revenue was ¥21,461 million in Japan, ¥8,219 million in the United States, ¥1,523 million in Germany and ¥6,531 million in other regions, and the company has sales subsidiaries in Europe and the United States, China and Taiwan. It is stated that no customer accounts for more than 10% of consolidated revenue.
entries.1065c4147f8d86d5: A business that manufactures and sells artificial graphite electrodes, impermeable graphite products, isotropic high-purity graphite products, graphite products for machinery, general-purpose carbon fibers and graphite fibers, resin-containing graphite fiber packing, flexible graphite sealing materials, and anode materials for lithium-ion batteries. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥32,397 million, consisting of ¥20,225 million from fine carbon-related products and ¥12,171 million from electrode materials-related products. Raw materials are manufactured by the company and Nippon Techno Carbon Co., Ltd., and processing and sales are handled by the company and the group companies.
entries.10865f95fd0a5b11: Its business model centers on carbon products and silicon carbide products, manufacturing and selling artificial graphite electrodes, fine carbon products and silicon carbide continuous fiber, and earning consideration for these sales.

entries.5de1da58bbcb3e56: The medium-term management policy 'GO BEYOND 2030', which starts in fiscal 2025 and sets 2030 as its final year, identifies sustained corporate growth and the realization of a sustainable society as its key challenges, under the management philosophy of 'a company with dreams and technology aiming for a society of love and science'. Its priority issues are 'improving profitability', 'promoting sustainability management' and 'strengthening shareholder returns'. By product, it cites expanding share of fine carbon-related products in Japan and overseas, establishing an optimal production system and cutting costs to match demand for electrode materials-related products, securing personnel and ensuring safe operations to meet rising demand for silicon carbide-related products, and commercializing power semiconductor-related products as a new business, among others.
